description: This file defines the MistralEmbedder class, which implements the IEmbedder interface to provide embedding functionalities using Mistral's API, wrapping an OpenAI-compatible embedder.

classes.name: MistralEmbedder
classes.description: Implements an embedder that uses Mistral's API with configuration for embedding texts.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the MistralEmbedder with API key and optional model ID, setting up the underlying OpenAI-compatible embedder.

methods.name: createEmbeddings
methods.description: Creates text embeddings using Mistral's API, with error handling and telemetry logging.

methods.name: validateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the embedder configuration by delegating to the underlying embedder, with error handling and telemetry.

methods.name: embedderInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the embedder, specifically its name.
